move_by_extension.statement: A visible top-level file moves to a subdirectory named by its lowercased extension (no_extension when none); a name collision gets a numeric suffix and never overwrites.

once_mode.statement: --once does a single pass over the target and exits 0.

watch_mode.statement: --watch keeps organizing files that appear after start until stopped.

log_moves.statement: Each move appends a line with timestamp, source and destination to organizer.log.

skip_subdirs.statement: Files inside subdirectories are not touched and nothing is recursed into.

skip_hidden.statement: Files whose names start with a dot stay in place.

single_file.statement: organizer.py is one self-contained module that is runnable as a script.

stdlib_only.statement: organizer.py imports only standard library modules.
